flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper (EMAIL channel for idType B, stages ENA/RD1/RD2), application-prod.properties (email.enableSmtp=false). ocmsadminui ManageTemplate (court template placeholders). ocmsadminapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no court summons reminder batch code
note: Sheet status and demo_remark are blank; story traced normally (1 point). The story asks a batch job to e-mail reminders with court summons details to unique companies, using e-mail addresses already obtained from DOS. There is no court summons batch, no unique-company selection and no court summons e-mail template. Only the generic notification mechanism NotificationSmsEmailHelper exists: it e-mails recipients with idType B (company) for normal notice stages (ENA/RD1/RD2), not court summons. DOS: DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. Only the generic company e-mail channel can be reused; the court summons batch, unique-company selection and reminder content do not exist.

steps.step: Company e-mail addresses have been obtained from DOS
steps.detail: No DOS integration exists in the backend. The only trace is the staff screen 'DOS Reports' (ocmsadminui/src/pages/Report/lists/ReportListDOS.tsx:82) with no controller or authorization mapping. The only code fetching UEN data from DataHive is DataHiveUenFinService, and not for court summons reminders (comment 'Create Work Item (PLACEHOLDER)' at line 1519). DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo.

steps.step: The batch job identifies the unique companies to e-mail in each batch
steps.detail: No court summons batch job or company de-duplication logic exists (grep 'court.?summons', 'unique', 'uen' across the six repos; results are only UI strings and the unrelated AxsNopoServiceImpl). The only cron touching court (PaymentAcceptanceCutoffServiceImpl.java:20-25) reads OcmsCourtCaseService for the payment cutoff, not for picking reminder recipients.

steps.step: OCMS sends the notification by e-mail to companies
steps.detail: A generic mechanism exists: determineDeliveryChannel picks EMAIL when idType = B (company), then the template is read from the database (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:378-380). But it runs for normal notice stages (ENA/RD1/RD2, lines 482-484), not for a court summons batch, and e-mail is skipped for DN1/DN2/DR3. In application-prod.properties:80 email.enableSmtp=false; the real server value cannot be verified from the repo. A generic shared mechanism, not the feature the story names, so Sebagian.

steps.step: The e-mail lists the court summons details that will be due soon
steps.detail: No template or query builds the details of court summonses nearing their due date. The template editor only knows generic placeholders (mention_date, mention_time, court_no, EditTemplateForm.tsx:78-79) with no backend consumer for a court reminder. NotificationSmsEmailHelper templates are only SMS_ENA/SMS_RD1/SMS_RD2 (lines 482-484) and AN_EMAIL (line 380).
